title: Find All Unique Pairs with Sum K
statement:
Given an array of integers and a target K, find all unique unordered pairs (a, b) such that a + b = K.

Print each pair on a separate line as "a b" with a <= b, sorted by the first element. If no pairs exist, print "NONE".
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: Each unique pair "a b" (a <= b) on its own line, sorted by a. Print "NONE" if no pairs exist.
